assessment: inventory.py:6-11 preflights each validated unique SKU against current batch-local remaining stock, deducts only after whole-order success, and appends one boolean result in input order. Rejection preserves prior successes and every current quantity; empty orders pass all() and exact fits use >=.

Only the initial stock copy is mutated. Integer subtraction preserves integer counts, validated uniqueness makes per-item preflight sufficient, and the trusted Python API receives no new validation policies. Complexity remains linear in total items plus the initial stock copy.

batch.py and command_codec.py have no diff against HEAD. Entire-batch JSON validation still finishes before reserve executes, with existing malformed-shape, duplicate ID/SKU, unknown SKU and invalid quantity errors intact.

Tests retain the six baseline cases and add explicit expectations for late shortage, standalone rejection, continuation, prior depletion, exact fit, zero stock, empty order/batch, deep input preservation and boolean/integer types through both APIs. The invalid-later-order test verifies the engine is never called. These cases detect partial spending, stopping at rejection, comparing with original inventory and rejecting exact exhaustion.
